notes.title: Weapons, Enemies, Levels, Bosses incoming!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everybody,[/p][p][/p][p]Big new update coming up, with a heap of new content and heaps more fun to the game![/p][p][/p][p]I won't spoil to much for everyone however, here's a list of some of the new things coming yoru way![/p][p][/p][p]New stage access.[/p][p]You can start from any stage you like. Each stage has a few number of levels at the minimum, and you don't have to start from stage 1 and go through every stage to get to the end. If your feeling courageous, start at stage 10 then skip to stage 14, and take on some way heavier enemies and crazy bosses earlier than ever!![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664100/8f7f1c5c12c93d700563e990ebe9d52a50fd68fd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]New weapons.[/p][p]A heap of new weapons to enter the spotlight, some big, some small and a lot of hardcore firepower![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664100/8fe9427fd02bc6611f9638b9b67a4d9193ed0c83.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]New enemies.[/p][p]Again, some totally wild and some so cute they'll eat you all up![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664100/17caaca487749541d8e3e77ab556d184948918b7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]New levels and stages.[/p][p]And some cool new level designs, animations and rad terrain to run around in and survive.[/p][p][/p][p]So, stay tuned, there's lots coming and it should be one hell of a fun vegging day![/p]

notes.title: Content coming soon
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We're back.[/p][p][/p][p]We've been busy, having our thoughts be focused on other work, life, you know how it gets, we've lost some focus from Veg out Crew FPS, but lately we've been working on new content, so get excited![/p][p][/p][p] heap of new content, hopefully sooner than later, will arise in VoC FPS, which we'll go into more detail below.[/p][p]But for now, keep calm, have a read and we appreciate your patience as we work through all this new stuff and get ready for deployment![/p][p][/p][p]Happy vegging!![/p][p][/p][p]Content upcoming:[/p][p]New stages and levels:[/p][p]Currently working through our many theme ideas for the new stages,, including fire, water and a few other fun ideas![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664100/c50f4da5f12f75e69737a310b3e5a14f0bc6887f.gif"][/img][/p][p]New enemies and bosses:[/p][p]A heap of new enemies will be added from the avocado, zucchini, spinach and more, to some radical bosses yet to be identified.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664100/1e8203d57e2cb554ffd0e77ef2603ea2748c377d.gif"][/img][/p][p]New weapons galore:[/p][p]The fun continues with a heap of new weapons, from the beetrootiser (Beetroot wepon), pumpkin pusher to the kiwi kicker and who knows, maybe even a cheese grater??[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664100/110ffb0c1b5bffacb5fb042e93e035e2196d657e.gif"][/img][/p][p]So again, stay calm, get ready for another veg kicking time!![/p]

notes.title: Single player action in Veg out Crew FPS!
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Going to be showcasing some single player action in my up and coming game Veg out Crew FPS. It's a old-school retro linear fps single player game full of weird and wacky things! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664100/90f31045dd62aa81f638d9e2fe0a53e98c588858.png[/img]

From fruit and vegetable enemies, heaps others in the makes, weapson that shoot different fruit and vegetables, house hold weapons and heaps more to come too. Big bosses and different environments, this is Veg out Crew FPS!

Come along and get to see one fun fuelled old-school retro FPS!
